name: agent-log
description: Live pane with the session's agent tree and a log of file reads/edits, tool outcomes and classic hook triggers, filterable per agent, by view (all, agent: tool calls, turns and plugins' model forks, harness: hooks, the text they injected, plugins' model forks and the permission rule behind each decision, context: injected text incl. the system prompt, with sizes) and by level (debug, info, notice, error); /agentlog toggles it, /agentlog <view> opens a view, /agentlog level <level> sets the level.
